method: Per-life mechanism readings on kernel dossiers (whole life daily every 15th session, last 22 sessions at 5 readings/session, final 3 sessions every reading; L0-L4 lanes: URF, D_k, Rev_k, S_UF, F_n, R_res, ignitions, extinctions). One independent reader per life, blind to the others, names the mechanism family and claims RELAX (short at next open, held up to 5 sessions) or HOLD_OFF. Pool: live-stair states in the month window from year_lanes, operating companies only (CS/ADRC). Filed before outcomes; L5 laws (read_symbol v3-20260819) govern staging separately.
custody_notes: SCSC's first reading returned family and mechanism but omitted the prediction field; it was re-read in full rather than filled in by hand. Both the omission and the re-read are recorded here.
